user_question: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain census tract polygon zones covering State College.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available dataset containing census tract polygons for State College. The result must be suitable as GeoPackage polygon zones for zonal statistics.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the mean elevation for each State College census tract from the supplied 30-meter elevation raster.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute per-zone mean elevation using state_college_census_tracts as the polygon zones and input_2 as the primary elevation raster. input_2 is the requested 30-meter source; input_1 is also supplied as an additional raster but must not replace input_2 for the requested result. Return a CSV table with one mean-elevation result per census tract.

requirements.scope: The retrieved dataset must contain census tract polygons covering State College.
The elevation raster used for the requested result and the census tract zones must have matching coordinate reference systems.
The primary elevation raster used for the requested result must have a pixel resolution no coarser than 30 meters.
The census tract zones must be available as a GeoPackage polygon dataset accepted by zonal statistics.
